title: Seal reading a book
svg:
<svg viewBox="0 0 100 100" xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- Body -->
  <ellipse cx="50" cy="72" rx="30" ry="22" fill="#7EC8E3"/>
  <!-- Belly highlight -->
  <ellipse cx="50" cy="76" rx="20" ry="14" fill="#A8DDF0"/>
  <!-- Head -->
  <ellipse cx="50" cy="45" rx="20" ry="18" fill="#7EC8E3"/>
  <!-- Face lighter patch -->
  <ellipse cx="50" cy="48" rx="14" ry="12" fill="#99D4EA"/>
  <!-- Eyes -->
  <ellipse cx="42" cy="43" rx="4" ry="4.5" fill="#2C5F7A"/>
  <ellipse cx="58" cy="43" rx="4" ry="4.5" fill="#2C5F7A"/>
  <!-- Eye shine -->
  <circle cx="43.5" cy="41.5" r="1.5" fill="#E8F7FD"/>
  <circle cx="59.5" cy="41.5" r="1.5" fill="#E8F7FD"/>
  <!-- Nose -->
  <ellipse cx="50" cy="50" rx="3" ry="2.5" fill="#2C5F7A"/>
  <!-- Whiskers -->
  <line x1="34" y1="48" x2="44" y2="50" stroke="#5BA8C8" stroke-width="1.2" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <line x1="34" y1="53" x2="44" y2="52" stroke="#5BA8C8" stroke-width="1.2" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <line x1="66" y1="48" x2="56" y2="50" stroke="#5BA8C8" stroke-width="1.2" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <line x1="66" y1="53" x2="56" y2="52" stroke="#5BA8C8" stroke-width="1.2" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <!-- Mouth smile -->
  <path d="M46 53 Q50 56 54 53" fill="none" stroke="#2C5F7A" stroke-width="1.2" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <!-- Flippers holding book -->
  <ellipse cx="30" cy="68" rx="8" ry="5" fill="#6BBAD8" transform="rotate(-20 30 68)"/>
  <ellipse cx="70" cy="68" rx="8" ry="5" fill="#6BBAD8" transform="rotate(20 70 68)"/>
  <!-- Book open -->
  <path d="M25 65 L50 62 L50 80 L25 83 Z" fill="#F4E04D"/>
  <path d="M75 65 L50 62 L50 80 L75 83 Z" fill="#FFD93D"/>
  <!-- Book spine -->
  <line x1="50" y1="62" x2="50" y2="80" stroke="#E6C220" stroke-width="1.5"/>
  <!-- Book pages lines left -->
  <line x1="30" y1="68" x2="46" y2="66" stroke="#D4B800" stroke-width="1" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <line x1="30" y1="72" x2="46" y2="70.5" stroke="#D4B800" stroke-width="1" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <line x1="30" y1="76" x2="46" y2="75" stroke="#D4B800" stroke-width="1" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <!-- Book pages lines right -->
  <line x1="54" y1="66" x2="70" y2="68" stroke="#C8A800" stroke-width="1" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <line x1="54" y1="70.5" x2="70" y2="72" stroke="#C8A800" stroke-width="1" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <line x1="54" y1="75" x2="70" y2="76" stroke="#C8A800" stroke-width="1" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <!-- Tail flippers -->
  <path d="M78 88 Q88 82 85 92 Q82 96 78 88Z" fill="#5BA8C8"/>
  <path d="M22 88 Q12 82 15 92 Q18 96 22 88Z" fill="#5BA8C8"/>
</svg>
